findings.passage: The starting state of a pseudorandom generator, used with a specified implementation to repeat a sample sequence.
findings.literal_claim: The seed is the generator's complete starting state.
findings.reader_inference: Saving a seed and saving the generator state are the same operation.
findings.reason: A seed initializes or determines the generator state; it need not be the state itself. NumPy's documented integer seed goes through SeedSequence to derive BitGenerator state. Chapter 14 correctly says the seed fixes the state, so the glossary should match it.
findings.evidence: https://numpy.org/doc/stable/reference/random/generator.html, seed parameter; live title NumPy v2.5, checked 2026-10-30.
findings.proposed_replacement: A value used to initialize a pseudorandom generator so that a specified implementation can repeat a sample sequence.

passage_answers.answer: Retain. Each numbered stage maps the actual command, motor rate/spikes, mechanical response and feedback to different quantities. Retain. At constant rate, thinning an M-times-faster Poisson process sums M independent exponential intervals; mean is 1/lambda, variance 1/(M lambda^2), hence CV=1/sqrt(M). Text limits this argument to constant rate and does not claim the complete recurrent spike trains are independent. Published CV values approximately .22 and .07 agree with main p.11. Earlier 01-foundations.md lines 109-116 teaches conditional spike generation and CV; 04c-eye-circuit.md lines 130-146 supplies the full thinning/renewal calculation.

Retain. Final main p.11 states N=30000, Nm=1000, tau_s=.020 s, A=.015 and tau_d approximately .070 s. Code Run_model.m gives dt=1e-5 and MOD=100, hence .001 s saved spacing; Full_model_simulation.m gives tau_MN=.010, seed, central-gaze initial state, Euler synaptic updates and velocity-before-position calculation. N-counting ambiguity and final Eq.35/code regression difference are stated as limits rather than resolved by assumption. No code execution or exact figure reproduction is claimed.

passage_answers.location: 14-simulation-tools.md lines 15-25; YAML SOFTWARE summary; table MATLAB row
passage_answers.answer: Retain. Author implementation is a reasonable first route for reproducing its figures, qualified by code access and verification limits. MATLAB fitting/trajectory/MSD roles are visible in source. NumPy Generator samples random variables; a seed fixes its initial state under a specified implementation. Recording generator, versions and call order is warranted; official v2.5 docs explicitly disclaim version compatibility. The chapter definition is correct; the glossary identity statement needs EYE-S1-01.

Retain. Mainali paper key resources names Python 3.11; STAR Methods names SciPy label/peak/KDE operations and Gudhi Betti-number calculation; archived implementation inspected for this task uses NumPy random arrays and SciPy smoothing. Gudhi's role is topology, not neural time integration. The status cells distinguish reported/verified tools from proposed optional tools.

Retain. Official SciPy 1.18.0 solve_ivp documentation specifies an ODE initial-value solver. A stochastic point process additionally needs event generation and jump rules; a Brownian model needs correctly scaled random increments. Fresh independent noise on arbitrary solver RHS calls does not define those laws. This warning is about model specification and does not falsely claim ODE solvers can never be embedded in a hybrid stochastic scheme.

Retain. Official scipy.ndimage.label treats nonzero entries as features and uses an explicit connectivity structure. Its 2D default excludes diagonal-only contact, while an all-neighbor structure merges it. Therefore counts and component sizes can change with that choice. It is not claimed that every change alters every map.

Retain. Official Brian 2 v2.11.0 documentation calls it a spiking-network simulator; its model page defines equation-based NeuronGroups and threshold/reset/custom events. It is identified as optional, and preserving model states/noise/update rules is a condition for comparison, not an assertion that Brian was used by the three papers.

passage_answers.location: 14-simulation-tools.md lines 33-39; YAML RESOLUTION title and summary
passage_answers.answer: Retain. Discretization's definition is correct for these finite time/space computations. Refinement at fixed physical parameters tests numerical error rather than changing the model; saving resolution is distinct from integration resolution. Reported statistics, repeat variability and a chosen acceptable difference give the correct limited meaning of convergence check, without promising proof of exact convergence.

Retain. Recomputed independently: D=.5 deg^2/s; h=.01 gives variance .01 and SD .1 degree, 100 steps/s, total variance 1. h=.0025 gives variance .0025, SD .05 degree, 400 steps/s, total variance 1. Wrong SD=.025 gives total variance .25. Units and conditional scope are correct. Gaussian increments of the reduced Brownian model are explicitly separated from point-process spikes and jumps. This is arithmetic, not an executed author simulation.

Retain. Halving grid spacing doubles the same physical smoothing/correlation length measured in samples. Holding sample width fixed halves the physical width, so it changes the model. The relation assumes the same physical domain and length, as the paragraph states. Earlier place model/simulation chapters explain physical versus grid/filter scales.

passage_answers.location: 14-simulation-tools.md lines 55-63; YAML RECORD title and summary
passage_answers.answer: Retain all five record items. Model source, parameter status, initial/boundary/noise settings, numerical/sample resolution, measurement and repeat uncertainty determine the target comparison. Retain. Monte Carlo definition is appropriate here; effective independent repeats govern sampling uncertainty. Overlapping windows are not independent whole trajectories, and fields from a map share one realization. Small deterministic/field checks before ensembles are a proposed diagnostic progression. Final physical-model/animal distinction correctly limits the evidence.
